prompt: The client asks: "Should we match a rival's 15% price cut?" Fact sheet: the rival cut prices 15%; we have lost 5% of volume in three months; our margin is 30%; a 15% cut would halve our profit per unit; the rival recently changed its logo. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: With a 30% margin, a 15% cut halves profit per unit, so volume would have to double to break even, while we have lost only 5% of volume so far. The main risk is that share losses speed up. Putting it together, don't match the price cut.
